Security & Access
PIN not set — using system default
Requires device biometric hardware (Face ID / Touch ID).
Say "J.O.B Systems unlock" during enrollment.
Notifications
Nudges you when a task or bill is due today/tomorrow, and for calendar events with a reminder set — works even with the app fully closed, via a scheduled server check every 15 minutes. That server check only sees tasks due today and events starting within 30 minutes (the only two things that actually sync to the cloud) — bill reminders and each event's custom reminder timing still only fire while this device has the app open or running in the background.
AI Integrations
These keys are stored in this browser's local storage, unencrypted, and used directly from the browser — there's no backend to hide them behind. Anyone with access to this device/browser profile can read them. Don't enter keys here on a shared or public computer, and rotate a key immediately if you ever suspect this device was compromised.
Free key: aistudio.google.com/apikey
If this voice name doesn't work, check Google's current TTS voice list and enter the correct name here — falls back to Onyx or browser voice automatically either way.
Google occasionally retires older model names. If Gemini chat starts failing with a 404, check current names at ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models and update here — no code change needed.
